title: Fashion Flower Set 27 Procreate Brushes
author: JeerawanTH
description:
Bring fashion illustration to life with the Fashion Flower Set, a collection of 27 Procreate brushes created for artists, illustrators, and fashion designers.
Each brush captures the charm of floral embroidery and vintage textile patterns, making it easy to design elegant outfits, modern prints, or botanical fashion artwork with just a tap of your Apple Pencil.
Whether you’re illustrating clothing, designing fabric prints, or adding floral elements to portraits — this set offers endless creative possibilities.
✨ What’s Included:
• 27 high-quality Procreate brushes
• Perfect for fashion, floral, and textile illustration
• Easy to use with Apple Pencil and iPad
• Great for adding embroidered or printed fabric details
🎨 Perfect for:
	•	Fashion design projects
	•	Textile and pattern artwork
	•	Digital sketching and concept art
	•	Feminine, vintage, or botanical themes
